source: docs/plan/261022-agent-composer.md (dashboard) §3–§4: routes, splitting rules, Goal vs Routine by who decides the end

kind.instructions: What does `item` ask the dashboard to do? Read `item` as one instruction a person typed into a development dashboard; `whole` is the full sentence it came from. Judge who decides when the work ends: the person's own finished work ends a goal; the outside world keeps making work for a routine.

criteria.task: Do one piece of work now (change code, run tests, write, fix, investigate) and then stop
criteria.goal: Reach an end the person's own work completes: a target value, a deadline, 'until', 'finish', or a one-time outside event after which a job is done ('when X ships, upgrade'), or asks to add or define a goal for a project
criteria.routine: Repeat the same kind of work with no end: on a schedule ('every week', 'monthly') or every time an outside event happens ('whenever an advisory appears'), or asks to add a routine
criteria.org-edit: Change an existing advice or quiet item (hold, dismiss, reword, reprioritise)
criteria.answer: Only answer a question about the current state; nothing should run or change

mode.instructions: If `item` is one piece of work in a project, how should it run? `state.plainRunning` says whether a session is already working on the main tree.

criteria.worktree: A self-contained change worth its own branch: a feature, a refactor, a fix that touches several files, anything a reviewer should see as one diff
criteria.plain: A small step that continues what the main session just did, or a command with no lasting change: run the tests, show the status, try that again, a one-line tweak

criteria.schedule: At recurring times (days of the week, a time of day, monthly)
criteria.watch-once: When an outside value or release changes once ('when Tauri 3 ships')
criteria.watch-each: Every time an outside value or feed changes ('whenever a new advisory appears')

criteria.none: Nothing: it is done when this one run finishes, or it repeats forever
criteria.milestones: Reaching a target the work moves toward step by step (a metric below a value, a feature complete)
criteria.deadline: A date or period ('this month', 'by Friday')

area.instructions: Which one of the project's top folders in `paths` will `item` most likely change? Choose `unknown` when the item names no part of the code or could touch many places.

vague_target.instructions: Does `item` ask to keep improving or fixing something without saying what result would count as finished (no metric, no target value, no deadline, no single outside event)?

criteria.true: Open-ended improvement: it could be a goal once a target is named, or a routine that never ends
criteria.false: It names a target, a deadline, a single event, or it is plainly one-off or plainly endless upkeep (checks, scans, reports)
